en.name: Yeti
en.ability: Once per game, the Demon may publicly guess that you are the Yeti. If correct, when they are executed that day, you are executed instead. If nobody is executed during the day, your team loses.

zh.name: 雪怪
zh.ability: 每局游戏限一次，恶魔可以公开猜测你是雪怪，如果猜中，当天他被处决时你会代替他被处决。如果白天没人被处决，你的阵营落败。
